pages.title: Unified Notes I
pages.text: The first unified volume, where infinity, hypernova metallurgy, reality anchors, geodesics and quantum superposition sit in the same paragraph without apology. Nothing here belongs to a single discipline any more. The paper itself seems to bend slightly along the lines of text.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Compressing a field into a point taught me to compress my notes too. Absolute infinity, a hypernova alloy ingot, a reality anchor, a geodesic thread, a superposition crystal and an eigenstate lattice went in; one volume of unified theory came out.
